summary:
Production-ready prompt for validating 5 English Tier 1 content types (Horror, Reddit Drama, What If, Unsolved Mysteries, Dark History) for a faceless YouTube channel targeting doom-scroll audiences.

Key improvements over previous prompts:
- Provides specific niches as INPUTS — no blind discovery phase that wastes time finding economics/finance niches
- Mandatory channel proofs (Leader + Challenger under 50K) with explicit PROOF FAILED reporting
- Dedicated AI Voice Viability section — the #1 risk for a non-native English speaker
- Production format filter — excludes animation-dependent niches, filters for AI photorealistic images + Ken Burns + voiceover
- Doom-scroller audience definition baked into context
- Comparison table is mandatory
- Anti-sycophancy + grounding anchors for Gemini
- Banned vocabulary enforcement
- 20+ search query minimum

Built with prompt-forge CREATE mode using RISEN template, optimized for Gemini 3.1 Pro (High).
